packet_simulation.arrival_model: fixed-size batch at the start of each sampled controller tick
packet_simulation.routing: unweighted shortest path recomputed for each packet on the current controlled adjacency
packet_simulation.link_failure_interpretation: physical-radio link absence is realized before packet routing and therefore contributes to no-route drops; additional within-tick link failures are disabled
packet_simulation.intervention_transition_interpretation: relay transition loss is reported separately but disabled because no measured handover-loss parameter is available
